effect.name: GM Vortex Warp Pro
effect.desc: Falloff-controlled cinematic vortex with spiral arms, turbulence and protected outer framing.
effect.shader: void main(){vec2 uv=acScreenNorm;vec2 aspect=vec2(acScreenSize.x/max(acScreenSize.y,1.0),1.0);vec2 q=(uv-center)*aspect;float r=length(q),a=atan(q.y,q.x);float mask=pow(clamp(1.0-r/max(radius,.001),0.0,1.0),falloff);float turb=sin(a*spiralArms-r*18.0+evolution)*turbulence*mask;float rot=twist*mask+turb;float c=cos(rot),s=sin(rot);vec2 warped=(mat2(c,-s,s,c)*q)/aspect+center;vec4 src=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,uv),dst=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(warped,0.0,1.0));gl_FragColor=mix(src,dst,mixAmount*mask);}
